"""Main alone runs finite host checks on the isolated upstream Monitor port."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, difflib, fcntl, hashlib, importlib.util, json, re, traceback

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/sync-v0143-monitor-cache-20261012')
BASE = W.parent / 'sync-latest-updates-20261012'
L = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
def module(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    value = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(value)
    return value
m = module('monitor_host_owner', O)
leg = module('monitor_python_findings', B / 'latest-update-mandatory-lints-cpp-v4.py')
leg.W, leg.P, leg.U = W, BASE, BASE
ENV = dict(PATH=str(L / 'venv/bin') + ':' + str(L / 'bin') + ':/usr/bin:/bin',
           HOME='/home/yayoi', USER='yayoi', LOGNAME='yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8',
           PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', HF_HUB_OFFLINE='1', TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE='1', MYPY_CACHE_DIR='/dev/null')
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--phase', required=True, choices=['lints', 'cpu'])
phase = parser.parse_args().phase

with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / ('main-update-monitor-' + phase + '-root-v1')
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, complete=False, passed=False, commands=[], phase=phase, gpu_executed=False,
             model_executed=False, performance_measured=False,
             source={'path': str(Path(__file__)), 'sha256': m.sha(Path(__file__))})
    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    def run(label, args, cwd=W, allowed=(0,), wall=300):
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, args, ENV, cwd, wall=wall, cpu=wall * 8 + 60,
                             rss_cap=16 << 30, text_cap=64 << 20, total_cap=96 << 20, file_cap=64 << 20)
        r.setdefault('evidence', {})[label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        return c, so.read_text(), se.read_text()
    try:
        head = run('source-head', ['/usr/bin/git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])[1].strip()
        assert head == 'ba6bc78321a20c3299a668cd2fb1ba43ca4bca6a'
        changed = run('changed-files', ['/usr/bin/git', 'diff', '--name-only', 'HEAD'])[1].splitlines()
        extra = run('new-files', ['/usr/bin/git', 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard'])[1].splitlines()
        files = sorted(set(changed + extra))
        assert files and all(p.startswith('serve/') and p.endswith(('.py', '.js', '.html', '.css')) for p in files)
        r['changed_source_pins'] = {p: m.sha(W / p) for p in files}
        tracked = run('tracked-files', ['/usr/bin/git', 'ls-files'])[1].splitlines()
        engine = [p for p in tracked if p.startswith(('src/', 'include/', 'cmake/', 'third_party/', 'tools/', 'data/'))
                  or p in ('CMakeLists.txt', 'requirements.txt', 'setup.py')]
        r['engine_equivalence'] = {p: m.sha(W / p) for p in engine if (W / p).is_file()}
        assert all(m.sha(BASE / p) == h for p, h in r['engine_equivalence'].items())
        if phase == 'lints':
            link = W / '.lint'
            if not link.exists():
                link.symlink_to(L, target_is_directory=True)
            assert link.resolve() == L.resolve()
            maps = {}
            existing = [p for p in files if (BASE / p).is_file()]
            for name in existing:
                maps[name] = {}
                for a, z, count in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, (BASE / name).read_text().splitlines(),
                                                           (W / name).read_text().splitlines(), autojunk=False).get_matching_blocks():
                    for i in range(count):
                        maps[name][z + i + 1] = a + i + 1
            bc, bso, bse = run('baseline-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *existing], BASE, (0, 1))
            cc, cso, cse = run('candidate-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *files], allowed=(0, 1))
            for tool in ('flake8', 'ruff', 'mypy', 'codespell', 'reuse', 'eslint', 'stylelint', 'tidy serve/web/index.html'):
                assert '== ' + tool in bso and '== ' + tool in cso, tool
            assert 'skipped (' not in bso + cso and 'possible secret' not in bso + cso
            assert not cso.split('== reuse\n')[-1].strip()
            before, after = leg.findings(bso + '\n' + bse), leg.findings(cso + '\n' + cse, maps)
            added = sorted(set(after) - set(before), key=repr)
            r['comparison'] = dict(baseline_exit=bc['exit_code'], candidate_exit=cc['exit_code'],
                                   baseline=before, candidate=after, added=added)
            save()
            assert not added, added
            # JSON/line-format follow-ups cover web tools whose default format is not path:line.
            def web_findings(tool, root, text, mapping):
                rows = []
                if tool == 'eslint':
                    for item in json.loads(text):
                        path = str(Path(item['filePath']).relative_to(root))
                        for finding in item['messages']:
                            line = finding.get('line', 0)
                            line = mapping.get(path, {}).get(line) if mapping is not None else line
                            rows.append((path, line, finding.get('ruleId'), finding['message']))
                elif tool == 'stylelint':
                    for item in json.loads(text):
                        assert not item.get('parseErrors') and not item.get('invalidOptionWarnings')
                        path = str(Path(item['source']).relative_to(root))
                        for finding in item['warnings']:
                            line = finding['line']
                            line = mapping.get(path, {}).get(line) if mapping is not None else line
                            rows.append((path, line, finding['rule'], finding['text']))
                else:
                    for line in text.splitlines():
                        hit = re.match(r'line (\d+) column \d+ - (Warning|Error): (.*)', line)
                        if hit:
                            n = int(hit[1])
                            n = mapping.get('serve/web/index.html', {}).get(n) if mapping is not None else n
                            rows.append(('serve/web/index.html', n, hit[2], hit[3]))
                        elif line.strip():
                            rows.append(('tidy-global', None, 'output', line.strip()))
                return rows
            commands = {
                'eslint': ['eslint', '--no-eslintrc', '-c', 'tools/lint/eslintrc.js', '--format', 'json', 'serve/web/app.js'],
                'stylelint': [str(L / 'node_modules/.bin/stylelint'), '--config', 'tools/lint/stylelint.config.mjs',
                              '--config-basedir', str(L), '--formatter', 'json', 'serve/web/app.css'],
                'tidy': ['tidy', '-config', 'tools/lint/tidy.conf', '-errors', '-quiet', 'serve/web/index.html'],
            }
            r['web_comparisons'] = {}
            for tool, args in commands.items():
                _, so, se = run('baseline-' + tool, args, BASE, (0, 1))
                b = web_findings(tool, BASE, se if tool == 'tidy' else so, None)
                _, so, se = run('candidate-' + tool, args, allowed=(0, 1))
                a = web_findings(tool, W, se if tool == 'tidy' else so, maps)
                new = sorted(set(a) - set(b), key=repr)
                r['web_comparisons'][tool] = dict(baseline=b, candidate=a, added=new)
                save()
                assert not new, (tool, new)
        else:
            lp = B / 'main-update-monitor-lints-root-v1/record.json'
            lint = json.loads(lp.read_text())
            assert lint['passed'] and lint['complete'] and not lint['active']
            assert lint['changed_source_pins'] == r['changed_source_pins']
            r['lint_receipt'] = {'path': str(lp), 'sha256': m.sha(lp)}
            r['source_pins'] = {p: m.sha(W / p) for p in tracked if p.startswith('serve/') and (W / p).is_file()}
            r['source_pins'].update(r['changed_source_pins'])
            _, so, se = run('full-server-regression', [str(L / 'venv/bin/python3'), '-B', '-m', 'unittest',
                                                      'discover', '-s', 'serve', '-p', 'test_*.py', '-v'], wall=900)
            hit = re.search(r'Ran (\d+) tests in ([0-9.]+)s', se)
            assert hit and re.search(r'^OK(?:\s|$)', se, re.M) and int(hit[1]) >= 558
            skips = re.search(r'^OK \(skipped=(\d+)\)', se, re.M)
            r['unittests'] = dict(tests=int(hit[1]), elapsed_seconds=float(hit[2]),
                                  skipped=int(skips[1]) if skips else 0,
                                  individual_results=[v for v in se.splitlines() if v.startswith('test_')])
            assert all(m.sha(W / p) == h for p, h in r['source_pins'].items())
        assert all(m.sha(W / p) == h for p, h in r['changed_source_pins'].items())
        r['complete'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
        r['traceback'] = traceback.format_exc()
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        r['passed'] = bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'))
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'complete', 'error')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
